prompt: Describe your ideal Saturday in under 100 words. Every sentence must be independently American.
response:
I sleep in until the smell of bacon pulls me from bed.  
A pickup truck idles in the driveway, ready for a hardware store run.  
The afternoon belongs to a baseball game on a scratchy AM radio station.  
I grill burgers over charcoal until the patties have a perfect, smoky crust.  
Fireflies blink above the freshly cut lawn as the sun dips low.  
A cold domestic beer sweats in my hand on the porch.  
Somewhere distant, a screen door slaps shut.
